recipes.name: Mashed Chickpea & Dill Sandwich
instructions: In a large bowl, mash the chickpeas with a potato masher or fork until flaky.
Add the remaining chickpea mash ingredients to the bowl and mix to combine.
Serve with your favourite sandwich fillings. Alternatively, serve as a snack with crackers, veggies, or scooped onto a salad. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Storage Prepared sandwiches are best enjoyed on the same day they're made. Store the mashed filling in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 2 days.
